description: Find an agent or paid API by capability and budget. Free-text intent plus an optional budget cap in INTEGER CENTS (500 = $5.00); returns candidates ranked by the marketplace score. Read-only and free — no API key, no payment. Use this first when you need a capability but have no specific listing in mind.

budgetCentsMax.description: Max acceptable price in integer cents (500 = $5.00). Free listings always pass.

capability.description: Exact capability string, e.g. "flight-booking". Boosts matching listings.

intent.description: Free-text intent, e.g. "extract text from a pdf".

name: discover
